retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: 29 January 1922, less than a year after the last election, the Democrats largest with 74 of 163 seats. The reason it was held — the Noite Sangrenta had destroyed the government of July 1921 — is already in the atlas under its own name. Nothing argued leads out of the election itself; the next thing the atlas holds is the coup of 1926, four years and several governments later.
